jeep-compass.author: Alexander Migl
jeep-compass.alt: Jeep Compass (2021 facelift) in red with black roof, front three-quarter view
jeep-compass.note: European Compass after the 2021 facelift, the same design India builds at Ranjangaon: honeycomb seven-slot grille, slim LED headlamps, new bumper. Left-hand drive.

jeep-compass.author: Andra Febrian
jeep-compass.alt: Jeep Compass (facelift) dashboard with 10.1-inch touchscreen, right-hand drive
jeep-compass.note: Indonesian-market Compass, imported from Jeep's Indian plant: facelift dashboard with free-standing 10.1-inch screen and digital cluster, as in the Indian car.

jeep-meridian.author: Gpkp
jeep-meridian.alt: Jeep Meridian in silver, front three-quarter view
jeep-meridian.note: Indian Meridian on Jeep's stand, Bangalore auto show, Nov 2025: MERIDIAN show plate, seven-slot grille with chrome surrounds. Show-floor shot.

jeep-meridian.author: Tokumeigakarinoaoshima
jeep-meridian.alt: Jeep Meridian (sold in Japan as Commander) in white with black roof, rear three-quarter view
jeep-meridian.note: Japanese Jeep Commander (3DA-H620) is the India-built Meridian sold under another name: same body, lamps and wheels; only the tailgate and door badges read COMMANDER.

jeep-wrangler.file: File:Jeep Wrangler JL FL 2.0T Unlimited Rubicon 5-door Sarge Green Clear Coat.jpg
jeep-wrangler.author: Ethan Llamas
jeep-wrangler.alt: Jeep Wrangler Rubicon four-door (2024 facelift) in Sarge Green, front three-quarter view
jeep-wrangler.note: 2.0 turbo Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon after the 2024 facelift (black slotted grille, no mast antenna), the version sold in India. US-spec car photographed in the Philippines; exterior identical.

jeep-grand-cherokee.author: Tokumeigakarinoaoshima
jeep-grand-cherokee.alt: Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited (fifth generation, two-row) in grey, front three-quarter view
jeep-grand-cherokee.note: Japanese-market five-seat Grand Cherokee Limited (WL), right-hand drive like India's Limited (O); same grille, lamps and wheels.

jeep-grand-cherokee.author: Tokumeigakarinoaoshima
jeep-grand-cherokee.alt: Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited (fifth generation, two-row) in grey, rear three-quarter view
jeep-grand-cherokee.note: Same Japanese two-row Grand Cherokee Limited (WL), the body India sells; slight wide-angle distortion.
